title_en_note: The source language here is German, not Chinese, and title_zh carries the German as printed on the front page at (54). The field is named for the reference patent's language and the biblio schema says so explicitly of abstract_zh; the same reading is taken here rather than inventing a title_de the schema does not declare. Translation was done by hand and checked against the compound the patent names for itself. German chemical nomenclature is close enough to English to look safe and is not: Chlor is the substituent prefix chloro and not the element chlorine, trifluorethoxy has no o after fluor where English trifluoroethoxy does, and Dion is dione. Each of those is a silent slip a machine translation makes look fluent. The compound is fixed independently of the title by the patent itself: [0002] names it Tembotrione, the front page classifies it C07C 317/24 and A01N 41/10, and Tabelle 7 gives an orthorhombic Pna21 cell for it. Tembotrione is 2-{2-chloro-4-(methylsulfonyl)-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]benzoyl}cyclohexane-1,3-dione, C17H16ClF3O6S; the title's phenyl-carbonyl construction and the benzoyl construction name the same connectivity.

assignees.name_note: Printed at (71) as 'Bayer CropScience Aktiengesellschaft, 40789 Monheim (DE)'. The legal form is kept in German because that is how the front page prints it and it contains no punctuation, so it survives finalise.py building the tag as name.lower().replace(' ', '_') without tripping patent.schema.json's ^[a-z_]+:[a-z0-9_/.+-]+$ constraint on tag values. The resulting tag is assignee:bayer_cropscience_aktiengesellschaft.

inventors_note: Written as objects rather than bare names on purpose. The biblio schema says a bare name takes its country from `jurisdiction`, and warns that this is a guess. Here it would be a wrong guess: `ep` is an issuing office and not a country, so all seven inventors would have been stamped EP. Every one of them gives a German postal address at (72), so each carries DE explicitly. The front page prints the academic title Dr. after six of the seven names and omits it for Dworacek; the titles are dropped here because they are not part of a name, and the omission is recorded rather than silently normalised. Names are kept in the front page's surname-first form.
abstract_zh: Es wird eine thermodynamisch stabile Kristallmodifikation des herbiziden Wirkstoffs 2-({2-Chlor-4-(methylsulfonyl)-3-[(2,2,2-trifluorethoxy)methyl]phenyl}carbonyl) cyclohexan-1,3-dion (Tembotrione) beschrieben. Diese thermodynamisch stabile Kristallmodifikation weist besondere Vorteile in der Stabilität von Suspensionformulierungen auf.
abstract_note: Transcribed from (57) on the front page, with the line-break hyphenation the two-column layout inserts removed so the words are whole. Two things are left exactly as printed rather than corrected: the stray space in 'carbonyl) cyclohexan-1,3-dion', and 'Suspensionformulierungen', which is missing the linking s of the normal German compound Suspensionsformulierungen. Both are the patent's own, not transcription errors. The umlaut in Stabilität is kept. An earlier version of this file dropped it and justified that as caution about non-ASCII reaching unchecked consumers; the adversarial audit pointed out that the same run's A4 artifact carries Ausfällungen and the degree sign, and both existing runs carry Chinese characters in this field, so the stated rationale did not hold and the field was silently less faithful than the rest of the run for no reason.
ipc_note: Printed on the front page at (51) as 'C07C 317/24 (2006.01)' and 'A01N 41/10 (2006.01)', with a space before the bracket where the CN patents print none. The classification edition is dropped, which is the form all three existing runs use, so the four runs' ipc_codes arrays stay comparable. A01N 41/10 is the first non-C07C code in this dataset: it classifies the use as a biocide rather than the compound, which is correct for a patent whose claims 13 to 16 are use and method-of-treatment claims.
legal_status_note: Google Patents reports this application as Withdrawn (legalStatusCat: not_active). The disclosure was not abandoned: the same family, 38984191, was granted as US8722582B2 and published as WO2009027004A1, both of which TARGETS.md lists as do-not-also-annotate. So the annotation records a withdrawn application whose content was granted elsewhere, and legal_status describes this document rather than the invention.

text_provenance.prose_source: The text layer, for pages 1 to 14 and 23. This is a born-digital EP publication and the German prose comes out clean, including the hyphenation the two-column setting inserts mid-word at every line break, which has to be repaired when a paragraph is reassembled.
text_provenance.what_the_text_layer_does_not_contain: Two things, and they are most of what this patent discloses. First, pages 15 to 22 carry 19 characters each, which is the running header 'EP 2 045 236 A1' and the page number and nothing else. Those eight sheets are the six Abbildungen of [0018], the Raman and infrared spectra of crystal modifications I, II and III, and they have no text layer at all. Second, and less obviously, the seven Tabellen do have a text layer but not a usable one: the extractor walks them row by row across every column, so Tabelle 1's six columns come out as the flat run 91, 921, 94, 976, 85, 867, 130, 952, which reads as one series and is in fact three pairs belonging to three different crystal forms. The numbers are present and the association between a number and the modification it measures is destroyed. That association is the entire content of Tabellen 1 to 6. So the vision pass is the primary source for the results here, as it was on CN111440099B, but for the opposite reason: there the tables were images with no text, here they are text whose layout is the meaning.
text_provenance.why_this_patent_is_shaped_differently: It discloses no synthesis. Not one bond is formed or broken anywhere in it. The three Ausfuehrungsbeispiele at [0055] to [0057] dissolve 2 g of tembotrione in acetone, ethanol or toluene at the boil and cool it slowly, and what differs between them is the crystal lattice the same molecule adopts. A2's reaction_class enum does carry recrystallisation, so these have a home, but every step in this run has the same substance on both sides of the arrow and no yield, no mass balance and no route.

priority_date_note: The front page prints no (30) priority field, so no earlier priority is claimed and the priority date equals the filing date, 24.08.2007 at (22). Recorded here because priority_date is the one required biblio field with no printed source on this document: it is derived from the absence of a (30) block plus the (22) filing date, and corroborated by Google Patents, which reports 2007-08-24. An audit flagged it as unverifiable from the page, which is correct as stated; this note says what it actually rests on.
unverifiable_from_the_document: Two required fields cannot be checked against the patent itself and come from Google Patents: family_id 38984191, which is a DOCDB identifier printed on no patent document, and legal_status Withdrawn, which is a later prosecution event and so could not appear on a document published in 2009. Both are recorded here rather than left to look as though the page supports them. Nothing downstream checks either value.
